title: Missing sameAs entity disambiguation and governance structure on root domain
evidence: The root domain homepage https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/ and about page https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/about/ lack sameAs entity links and Schema.org disambiguation to distinguish Mozilla Foundation (non-profit parent) from Mozilla Corporation (taxable subsidiary), relying solely on external knowledge graphs.

suggested_action.summary: Add sameAs disambiguation links and subsidiary structure to Organization schema on the root domain.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add Organization JSON-LD to https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/ including sameAs URIs for Wikidata (Q9661, Q169925) and Wikipedia, explicitly defining the parentOrganization / subOrganization relationship.
